errors.text_span: The bars for the fine-tuned models are generally shorter (more negative), indicating lower probabilities.
errors.evidence: In the figure, the baseline light-blue bar is not always the tallest/least negative in every group; some fine-tuned bars are taller than the baseline in several specialty groups. The statement overgeneralizes the bar-height relationship.

errors.text_span: The shortest bars (most negative) in each group correspond to the Neuro specialty, which is represented by the dark orange bars.
errors.evidence: The darkest brown/dark orange bars are not the shortest in every group; in some groups another specialty bar is equally short or shorter. The description assigns a uniform minimum to Neuro that is not supported by the chart.
The description does not mention the legend placement at the top center, which is a visible structural feature noted in the reference.
